criteria.description: Leads with Not ready because material billing and entitlement changes violate the explicit invariant and remain untested.
Captures the requested copy changes and the explicit no-change invariant for plans, prices, discounts and entitlements.
Clearly identifies the discount and SSO mapping as unexpected high-blast-radius changes, not harmless implementation detail.
Marks copy Pass and billing/entitlement invariants Fail, without treating snapshot tests as checkout evidence.
Requires reverting the two orphan changes and verifying affected billing/entitlement behaviour before shipping.
Explains commercial and customer consequences in plain language.
